market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $100 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI hit $106.42 on May 4 and traded above $100 most of early May 2026 due to Strait of Hormuz disruption. If market was created early in May, it likely already resolved YES. Even if created post-spike, current WTI ~$97 with active geopolitical risk gives material chance of re-touching $100. Most of probability is priced in.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Exact market creation timestamp; whether geopolitical escalation pushes back above $100.
